# Healthonomic Primary Care

> Adult primary care practice in the south suburbs of Chicago (Cook County, IL).
> Internal medicine, family medicine, preventive care, and chronic-condition
> management. Same-day appointments, extended hours, and video (e-)visits available.

## Services

Primary care, internal medicine, family medicine, wellness check-ups, physicals and
sports physicals, blood pressure/hypertension, diabetes management, heart disease,
asthma, COPD, arthritis, gout, colitis, women's health, minor wound care, COVID-19
testing, preventive care, and telehealth/e-visits.

## Insurance

Accepts Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois, Cigna, Devoted Health, Humana,
UnitedHealthcare, and Original Medicare. Participation varies by plan - contact us to verify.

## Patients & scheduling

Book a video or in-person visit through the LiveWell (MyChart) portal
(https://livewell.aah.org) or by calling your preferred location. Same-day appointments available.

## Language assistance

Free language assistance available, including Spanish, Polish, and Greek.
